declared.title: Improving mental health by training the suppression of unwanted thoughts
declared.foundIn: agent contre-preuve, recherche Crossref / Europe PMC du 2026-11-22 (reports/feeling-bad-about-feeling-bad/counter-evidence.md) ; titre relevé sur Crossref par l'agent : contrôle d'identité plus faible

findings.text: Three days of training to suppress fearful thoughts lowered anxiety and depression, without any rebound

support.sentence: After training, participants reported less anxiety, negative affect, and depression with the latter benefit persisting at 3 months.

limits: one lab, no independent replication among 35 citing articles
the paradigm it rests on failed a preregistered replication (Wiechert et al. 2023, 10.1080/09658211.2023.2208791)
allegiance: the lab that created the think/no-think paradigm
